The balance sheet shows substantial scale and a solid equity base, with retained earnings also indicating long-term earnings accumulation, but leverage is still fairly high at roughly 74% of assets and liquidity is somewhat weak with a current ratio below 1. Combined with only moderate operating earnings relative to the liability load, this supports an investment-grade rating in the lower-to-mid BBB area rather than a stronger A-category profile.

DECISION: BBB+
